cq_coverage.details: All competency questions are addressed with clear class/property structures. Roles, organizations, items, prices, amounts, identifiers, and business process assignment are all modeled, supporting direct or indirect answers to each CQ.

strengths: Deep, multi-level hierarchy from Interchange to Data Elements
Comprehensive use of restrictions and equivalence
Rich disjointness and disjoint union axioms
weaknesses: No explicit cardinality constraints for some mandatory elements (could be improved with minCardinality)
No explicit subclassing for some technical EDIFACT segment types (e.g., BGM, NAD as subclasses of EDIFACTSegment)

likely_oops_pitfalls: P4: Missing domain or range for some properties (none detected, but always verify)
P7: Missing inverse properties for all object properties (most are present, but double-check completeness)

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Add explicit minCardinality restrictions for mandatory properties (e.g., Invoice must have at least one InvoiceHeader, InvoiceDetail, and InvoiceSummary section).
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Improves validation and ensures required structure for EDIFACT compliance.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Model BGM and NAD as subclasses of EDIFACTSegment to allow segment-specific constraints and facilitate querying for segment types.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Enhances technical fidelity and enables more precise queries.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Add rdfs:seeAlso or skos:example annotations referencing which classes/properties answer each CQ.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Improves documentation and makes CQ coverage auditable.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Increase use of owl:hasKey or additional equivalence axioms for identifying unique instances (e.g., Invoice uniquely identified by reference number and date).

summary: The ontology is well-structured, deeply hierarchical, and covers all competency questions with appropriate OWL 2 constructs and best practices. Only minor improvements are needed for cardinality and technical segment subclassing. No OWL 2 compliance or validator issues were detected.
